answer: A tide-gated wharf registry stops Sybil attacks. Each agent docks at a wharf with a $60 stake locked 90 epochs. Every epoch a tide window opens at an unpredictable time; each agent signs within 20 minutes. Each success plants one orchard tree; 30 trees earn established status, a miss withers one. Forging 1,000 identities costs $60,000 locked plus 1,000 signatures per 20-minute window across 1,000 keys, tending 30,000 trees. Like a harbor roll call when the tide turns: one captain covers one ship, but a thousand ghost ships need a thousand captains at 3 AM.
